name: rime-pinyin-simp word data
conversion: Remove the fixed YAML metadata header, validate every data row, retain all word/pinyin/integer-frequency rows in their original order, emit UTF-8 without BOM and LF newlines with a source/license header. No engine or Rime configuration is imported.

provenance.upstream_header: Derived from android open source project: platform/packages/inputmethods/PinyinIME.git

scope: A basic word-data baseline for the Rust core. Not a complete modern Chinese corpus or a claim of everyday input quality. Attribution and license texts must accompany distribution.
